public_sources.scope: GitHub exact repository/code searches plus HICAI-ZJU/SciToolAgent public branches
public_sources.result: No SciToolAgent-Evo implementation/revision was discovered in the checked public GitHub surfaces; the base SciToolAgent repository exposed only main during this run.

observations.text: The paper defines each experience e=(d_e,s_e,a_e,h_e), where s_e is the applicable scientific situation.

The formal test-time experience retrieval rule is E_q = E_gen union TopK(E_{d_q}, q, K). It exposes domain and semantic-query retrieval but does not explicitly expose an s_e compatibility predicate/filter before the experience enters context.
After retrieval, q and E_q condition generation of Active Requests, and tool candidates are then retrieved/reranked against those requirement descriptions and ontology structure.

inference.name: DECLARED_APPLICABILITY_IS_NOT_ENFORCEMENT
inference.text: Applicability metadata should not be credited as an enforced adoption gate unless runtime has an explicit compatibility check or equivalent deterministic/inspectable consumption. Metadata may still influence an LLM implicitly, but that is a weaker claim.

causal_boundary: The Active Request ablation supports requirement-conditioned scientific tool routing, not a matched receiver-side negative-memory applicability intervention. Exact runtime consumption of s_e remains unresolved without implementation.
next_probe: Locate an exact public implementation/artifact revision for SciToolAgent-Evo or author supplementary material that shows whether s_e participates in deterministic retrieval/reranking/adoption.
